summary: At a place w above N, w or w̄ lies in P; at P the component is inclGL(a), at P̄ its conjugate.

steps.claim: Let w be a finite place above N (o: N ∈ w).

By natCast_mem_iff, w ∈ P or w̄ ∈ P. In the first case g_w = inclGL(a)_w ∈ GL_n(O_w); in the second the component at w̄ is integral invertible, and the component at w is its conjugate inverse transpose (atPlace_star_mem_iff), again integral invertible.
